questions.q: How would I get a valuation for my apartment building?
questions.theirs: The official free, no-obligation valuation request asks name, address, email and unit count. The six-stage process begins Engagement then Fit, which may lead to no sale or no work with the team. It is a request, not an instant value or contract.
questions.ours:
You can use the team’s [free valuation request](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107508&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=WmRcP6mBHWQQ&link=https%3A%2F%2Fsimonandersonteam.com%2F%23valuation). The form asks for your name, property address, email and number of units. The site describes it as “no obligation, just information.”

It’s a request for a valuation, not an instant automated estimate.

**Visitor:** I am only exploring. I do not want to give my address or email.

**Subsights:** That’s fine—you can explore without sharing those details or contacting the team.

The team describes its process as starting with a discussion of your needs, followed by deciding whether working together is a fit. It says the best path may not involve the team or even a sale. You can read the [six-stage process](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107510&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=WmRcP6mBHWQQ&link=https%3A%2F%2Fsimonandersonteam.com%2Fhow-we-do-it%2F) and browse [public market reports](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107510&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=WmRcP6mBHWQQ&link=https%3A%2F%2Fsimonandersonteam.com%2Fmarket-reports%2F).

The valuation request asks for an address and email; I can’t calculate a building value here.

**Visitor:** Does this mean I have to sell?

**Subsights:** No. Exploring a valuation doesn’t mean you have to sell. The team says the best path may not involve a sale or working with them at all; a contract is signed only if you decide to work together.

You can read about the [team’s process](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107512&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=WmRcP6mBHWQQ&link=https%3A%2F%2Fsimonandersonteam.com%2Fhow-we-do-it%2F) without sharing your details.

**Visitor:** What happens first if I later choose to work with them?

**Subsights:** The first stage is **Engagement**: discussing your needs. Next is **Fit**, where you and the team decide whether working together makes sense. The team says a contract is signed if you decide to work together.

You can read the [six-stage process](https://bot-api.subsights.com/links/click?message_id=107514&workspace_public_id=0XvceSLk1j&chatbot_public_id=WmRcP6mBHWQQ&link=https%3A%2F%2Fsimonandersonteam.com%2Fhow-we-do-it%2F) without contacting them.
questions.outcome: Native valuation fields and request distinguished from instant value. No-contact exploration retains useful process and research. Fit does not imply sale or obligation. Engagement then Fit and native process, no executed contract.
